description: Pinned raw downloads of docs/DATA_PLAN.md, written by scripts/data/fetch_raw.py: per source the Hugging Face repo, full revision, destination and every file with bytes and sha256. Files under `dest` are never modified after the fetch.

swesmith_py.purpose: SWE-smith Python task instances: SWE dev tasks (WP6) and the stage-2 SWE pool (WP8)

swesmith_go.purpose: SWE-smith Go task instances: SWE dev tasks (WP6) and the stage-2 SWE pool (WP8)

tgr.purpose: TermGrade episodes (messages format) and the per-trial verifier rewards: DeepSeek-V4-Pro (MIT), the first build's terminal teacher (WP4); Kimi-K3 (moonshotai/Kimi-K3, Kimi K3 License, MIT-style; served from the open weights by the dataset authors), the revision-5 terminal teacher (docs/DATA_PLAN_v5.md 3.2); with Qwen3.6-27B (Apache-2.0), Gemma-4-31B-it with reasoning on (gemma_think, Apache-2.0) and GLM-5.2 (MIT), the terminal revision-3 teachers in that priority order after Kimi-K3 (Dean, 2026-10-13)

th3k_env_meta.purpose: TerminalHorizon environment metadata (the `category` of each environment) for the WP4 category quota; the 6.9 GB task tarballs are not fetched

scale_swe_verified.purpose: Scale-SWE instances that pass gold validation: the admission list of the Scale-SWE rows (WP3)

swe_rebench_v2.purpose: SWE-rebench-V2 task rows with reference patches: the size strata of the SWE draw (WP3)

bge_small.purpose: embedding model of the D3/D5' screens and the chat topic classifier: the transformers AutoModel/AutoTokenizer files plus the sentence-transformers pooling configs (no ONNX, no .bin weights)

tgr_env.purpose: TermGrade's 1,004 task directories, base image, task, label and task-source tables: terminal dev tasks (WP6) and the stage-2 terminal pool (WP8)

th3k.purpose: TerminalHorizon-3K DeepSeek-V4-Pro trajectories: the unverified terminal teacher rows (WP4). The JSONL is byte-identical to revision 1d5db7175868d6abe901616874f86a9f8447d7d5, which the plan measured; this revision's card adds the paper link and citation

oswt.purpose: Open-SWE-Traces v1.2 mini-swe-agent Qwen3.8-27B trajectories, both task-source folders: the SWE teacher rows (WP3)

nm_math.purpose: retention math (WP5). The AoPS chain-of-thought rows (source == 'AoPS', subset == 'cot'; 51,961 rows: 23,605 + 23,654 + 4,702) all sit in shards 0 to 2 at this revision; the shards are sorted by subset, then source (counted from their source and subset columns). Shards 3 to 11 hold the Math StackExchange (CC-BY-SA) chain-of-thought rows and the tool-integrated (TIR) rows

nm_ifchat.purpose: retention instruction following and chat (WP5). The chat split ships the lmsys- and WildChat-seeded prompts as null (the lmarena-seeded ones are present); prepare_chat_prompts.py, which would restore them, is fetched, not run

nm_sci.purpose: retention science (WP5): the MCQ split and the RQA split (free-form chemistry questions)
